source_text:
τῆς πολιτείας ἀποστὰς, γενοῦ μεθ' ἡμῶν, σαββάτιζε μεθ' ἡμῶν, τὰ ἄζυμα ποίει μεθ'
ἡμῶν, καὶ τὰς ἄλ λας τοῦ νόμου παρατηρήσεις. Αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἱ φόνου μετέχοντες.
Ἀγαθῶν μὲν γάρ ἐστιν ὁ Θεὸς δοτήρ· κακῶν δὲ ἡμεῖς αἴτιοι, δη λαδὴ κακωτικῶν.
Φαίης δ' ἂν ταῦτα καὶ περὶ τῶν μετασχόντων αἵματος Ἰουδαίων, τῶν τε προφητῶν
καὶ αὐτοῦ τοῦ Χριστοῦ. Αὗται αἱ ὁδοί εἰσι πάντων τῶν συντελούντων τὰ ἄνομα.
Συντελεῖν οὐχ ἁπλῶς οἶμαί τι ποιεῖν, ἀλλὰ πληρῶσαι τὸ μέτρον τῶν πατέρων
αὐτῶν, καὶ ὑπο κεῖσθαι παντὶ αἵματι ἀπὸ Ἄβελ μέχρι Ζαχαρίου. Σοφία ἐν ἐξόδοις
ὑμνεῖται. Σιωπωμένη μὲν ὑπὸ σοφοῦ, οὐχ ὑμνεῖται· ἐξόδου δὲ τυχοῦσα, ὑμνεῖται.
Ἔσται γὰρ ὅταν ἐπικαλέσησθέ με. Ὡς Κύριον γὰρ ἐπικαλούμεθα τὴν σοφίαν οὖσαν
Χριστόν. Ὁ οὖν ἐπικαλούμενος τὸν Χριστὸν, εἰ νοεῖ τίς ἐστιν, ἐπικαλεῖται σοφίαν,
σύνεσιν, ἁγιασμὸν, δικαιοσύνην, καὶ πᾶσαν ἀρετήν· εἰ καὶ μὴ χείλεσιν, ἀλλὰ πράξε
σιν. Ἀλλὰ μὴ τοιοῦτοι γενώμεθα, ὡς ἐπικαλεῖσθ
pass_a_gloss: Having withdrawn from that citizenship, join us: sabbath together, keep unleavened rites together, and the remaining law observances. They themselves share in murder. God gives goods; of evils — harmful things — we are causes. Say this also of Jews who shared blood, of the prophets and of Christ himself. These roads belong to all who complete lawless acts. Complete does not mean merely perform a deed; it means fill the fathers measure and lie under every blood from Abel through Zechariah. Wisdom is hymned in goings-out. Silent under a wise keeper, it receives no hymn; once it gains an exit, hymn follows. There will be a season when you call on me. As Lord we invoke the wisdom that is Christ. So the caller on Christ, if he grasps who that is, invokes wisdom, understanding, sanctification, righteousness, and the whole of virtue — by practices if not by lips. May we not become callers he refuses to hear. Chapter 2: If you receive a saying of my command and hide it with yourself. Hiding here is not empty glory performance but eagerness to stay unnoticed. Then you will grasp fear of the Lord. Notice after how many steps that fear is grasped; it too is unclear, as simpler people show — some fear where they need not, and fail to fear where they ought. Give your voice to understanding. Each assigns voice to something: to anger saying its lines, or grief, or sexual immorality. The blessed dedicate the whole voice to the Lord so that whatever is spoken may be wisdom. Seek wisdom the way another seeks silver, becoming a lover of silver in this. Do not let a bad counsel overtake you. Outsiders to the Church promise one start and another finish: first they pull people from idols toward the Creator; then they shift and discard Old Scripture, opposing elemental youth. Church teachers keep ends matching the first elements. Chapter 3: Let your heart keep my words. After God law commands and bans, God wisdom words announce unlying knowledge of what exists. Matching that: Out of Zion the law will go, and a Lord word out of Jerusalem. Law-keepers take up wisdom. Sow righteousness for yourselves; harvest into a season of life. Next to the practical: light yourselves a knowledge light. Provide good things before Lord and humans. Practice done in wisdom makes you a son of God, as You made all things in wisdom. Honor the Lord from just labors. Scripture habitually takes honor as gift: Honor widows, the true widows means Share, so the widow is not humbled by withheld language of alms. The Savior also: It stands written in the law: Honor father and mother, and what follows. From just labors blocks seizure and greed. No one should hesitate to give; after the holy Gospel widow who cast her whole living and was justified — not beside givers from seizure but beside givers from surplus — no defense remains. Every gift toward God includes temperance works and the rest of the virtues. Give firstfruits of every offspring to Church and poor; rising from sleep give prayer as God firstfruit; give firstfruits of words — psalms. Then it is said: Blessed your storehouses and leftovers — meaning soul things. God founded earth by wisdom. The faithful soul too is earth, fruitful a hundredfold. From that richness which is wisdom she becomes wise as God founds her on it. He seats teaching introduction for her, fixing from wisdom, and as she advances he works her into a heaven: purest creature, dwelling of angels and thinking essences. Taking perception of what is, contemplating exactness of affairs, she begins to divide and cut through. Chapter 5: Make your road far from her. Road names the mind traveling on virtue; or he orders virtue cut away from vice. And a woman of men hunts precious souls
pass_b_english: …leave that way of life, be with us, keep sabbath with us, keep the unleavened rites with us, and the other law observances. For they themselves share in the murder. God gives good things; we are causes of evils — of things that harm. You would also say this of the Jews who shared in blood, both of the prophets and of Christ himself. These are the roads of all who complete lawless deeds. To complete, I think, is not merely to do something, but to fill the measure of their fathers, and to be liable for every blood from Abel as far as Zechariah.

Wisdom is hymned in goings-out. Kept silent by a wise man, it is not hymned; once it obtains a going-out, it is hymned. For there will be a time when you call upon me. As Lord we call upon the wisdom that is Christ. So whoever calls upon Christ, if he understands who he is, calls upon wisdom, understanding, sanctification, righteousness, and every virtue — if not with lips, then with practices. But let us not become the sort who call, only for him not to listen.

Chapter 2: If, receiving a saying of my commandment, you hide it with yourself. Someone hides it not for empty glory, but eager to escape notice. Then you will understand fear of the Lord. See after how many steps we will understand that fear; it too is unclear, as simpler people show: some fear the Lord where they need not, and do not fear where they ought. And give your voice to understanding. Each person gives his voice to something — to anger speaking its lines, or to grief, or to sexual immorality. The blessed one dedicates his whole voice to the Lord, so that whatever he speaks may be wisdom. As another seeks silver, seek wisdom that way, becoming a lover of silver in this. Let a bad counsel not overtake you. Those alien to the Church promise one thing at the start and another at the end: first they pull people from idolatry toward the Creator; then they change and set aside the Old Scripture, opposing elemental youth. With church teachers the ends agree with the first elements.

Chapter 3: Let your heart keep my words. After the commands and bans of God law, the words of God wisdom announce unlying knowledge of the things that are. Such also is Out of Zion will go the law, and a word of the Lord out of Jerusalem. Whoever keeps the laws will take up wisdom. Sow for yourselves righteousness; harvest into a time of life. Then next to the practical comes: Light for yourselves a light of knowledge. Provide good things before the Lord and humans. If you do what you practice in wisdom, you will be a son of God, as it says: You made all things in wisdom. Honor the Lord from your just labors. Divine Scripture customarily takes honor for a gift: Honor widows, the true widows means Share, so as not to humble the widow by refusing to say alms. The Savior also says: It is written in the law: Honor your father and your mother, and what follows. He said from just labors so it would not be from seizure and greed. Let no one hesitate to give; after the Gospel widow who threw her whole living and was justified — not beside those who threw from seizure, but beside those who threw from surplus — no one has a defense. Everything is a gift toward God: works of temperance and the other virtues. Give firstfruits from every offspring to Church and poor; rising from sleep give prayer as firstfruit to God; give a firstfruit of words — psalms. Then it will be said to you: Blessed are your storehouses and your leftovers — meaning the things of the soul.

God founded earth by wisdom. The faithful soul too is earth, bearing fruit a hundredfold. From that richness, which is wisdom, she becomes wise, as God founds her upon it. He seats the introduction of teaching for her, fixing it from wisdom, and as she always advances he works her into a heaven — a most pure creature, a dwelling of angels and thinking essences. Taking perception of what is, and contemplating the exactness of affairs, she begins to divide and cut them through. Chapter 5: Make your road far from her. He calls road the mind traveling on virtue; or he also commands to separate virtue from vice. And a woman of men hunts precious souls
